pool.text: Bulawayo was founded as the kraal of Mzilikazi by Gundwane Ndiweni
British South Africa Company soldiers captured the settlement during the First Matabele War
Leander Starr Jameson declared Bulawayo a settlement under the rule of the BSAC
Solusi University, a Seventh-day Adventist institution, was established in Bulawayo
At the outbreak of the Second Matabele War, Ndebele forces besieged Bulawayo
The new town of Bulawayo acquired the status of municipality
Bulawayo attained and received official city status
Aberdeen in Scotland became a sister city of Bulawayo
The National University of Science and Technology was established in Bulawayo
Population decline and slow growth disproportionately affected heavy industry in the city
Solusi University in Bulawayo gained official university status
The city faced an avoidable cholera outbreak due to previous growth issues
Polokwane in South Africa became a sister city to Bulawayo
The census listed the population of Bulawayo at 665,940 residents
